input.composition: Pinned PR #56 integration candidate containing PR #47, #49, #51, #52 and #56 changes. Separate candidates such as PR #54 and #55 are not composed into this input.

workspace_registration.status: Unchanged. This dedicated structure input pin does not update the ordinary city registration or approve unrelated candidates.

implementation.scope: Static exterior geometry: FootTown shell, lower lift enclosure, turning stairs, roof access, leg/base connection details, open upper lift support frame, guide members, two small rescue landings and illustrative stationary cars. Upper revision: adjacent two-face / three-pane cabin, mirror ceiling, suspension sling, two T guides with brackets, seven visible ropes, rescue doors and grating, adjacent service stairs; painted upper members inherit PR56 bands.
not_implemented: Lift operation, mechanical engineering, structural verification or animation
Surveyed reconstruction of the building, foundations or tower profile
FootTown shop interiors, signs or exact current floor plan
Interior doors or a verified walkable route from the stair termination through the main deck
Relocation of the inherited main deck or top deck
Unlocated counterweight and return ropes, hidden full-wrap traction sheaves and machine room internals
Exact current shaft framing schedule, antenna service platforms and electrical cable routes

sources.title: 東京タワー耐震改修工事報告
sources.publisher: 宮地エンジニアリング
sources.locator: 宮地技報 No.28, printed pages 64-70; overall elevation on printed page 65 (PDF page 2)
claims: The overall elevation distinguishes wide outer legs and lower arches from the narrow central lift assembly and the building below.
The central upper vertical system is identified for elevator-shaft steel reinforcement between the observation-deck regions.
The diagram labels H11 as GL+120.000m, H23 as GL+223.500m, H27 as GL+252.650m and the top as GL+333.000m.
limitations: The diagram includes construction stages and temporary equipment; these are not all permanent external features.
The meaning of the difference between H11/H23 GL labels and the operator's 150m/250m deck descriptions was not established from primary evidence.
Do not reinterpret the diagram labels as surveyed deck-floor heights or move the inherited decks on that basis.

model_estimates.classification: All values below are local scene-fit values, inherited approximations or visual estimates, not measurements from the cited sources.

foottown.basis: Retained legacy model footprint; not confirmed by a dimensioned primary drawing.
foottown.roof_opening_basis: A central square opening clears the modeled lower lift envelope; its dimensions are a scene-fit choice, not surveyed roof geometry.

roof_access_doorway.basis: An opening in the stair-entry enclosure; side and dimensions are inferred, not a verified real-world entrance orientation.

stairs.basis: 46 x 13 = 598 is a modeling choice consistent with an approximately 600-step route; it is not a claim that the real staircase has exactly 598 steps.
stairs.termination: The final tread matches the inherited Photo based main deck floor level at Z=145.1m and terminates within the central equipment region. No interior doorway or verified walkable route is modeled.

lower_lift.basis: Slim framed/glazed exterior envelope inferred from photographs and fitted to the retained roof and main-deck geometry.

upper_lift.basis: No walls is sourced. The 3.6m square, four posts and 24 intervals remain an inherited modelling approximation, not a newly established real-world arrangement. Flanged members, splice plates, guides and brackets add visible structure but their sections and allocation are interpolations; T_018 does not distinguish every tower member from shaft-specific members.
upper_lift.rescue_landing_basis: Count and doors/jambs/sills are sourced. Levels, doorway sizes, gratings, walkway layout and guard geometry are inferred.
upper_lift.rope_basis: Seven is sourced. Only the car-to-upper-termination segment is represented, connected through sockets to the car crosshead. Counterweight position and the hidden full-wrap route are not established or modeled.
upper_lift.guide_section: Two compound T sections with discrete brackets and car shoes; dimensions and positions are inferred.
upper_lift.paint: Copied PR56 orange-object material applies the same inherited height bands to new frame, support links and service stairs without changing the original shader.

service_stairs.basis: Existence of the adjacent stair route is observed in the 2021 exterior panorama. Counts and dimensions fit the inherited scene and inferred rescue levels; not a claim about actual step count.
service_stairs.fit_note: Width is a modelling fit, not measured. A wider first candidate intersected the retained top trusses; this footprint is checked against saved original geometry.

cars.lower: Original simple lower static envelope unchanged.

upper.basis: Face/pane arrangement and finishes are sourced. Static pose, dimensions, world orientation, roof enclosure, sling, rail shoes and fasteners are inferred.

model_estimates.base_connections: Small plates and fasteners fitted to inherited leg/pedestal joints; size, number and geometry are unverified visual detail. No underground foundation reconstruction.
model_estimates.decks: Inherited deck positions and geometry are retained. The differing published height conventions remain unresolved.
model_estimates.inherited_main_deck_interface: In the pinned city, the old tower main-deck floor is absent and the Photo based main deck interior omits a central floor region of approximately +/-9m. This is a description of the inherited model, not a claim about the real building. The exterior stairs end inside that equipment region; interior circulation remains outside this revision.

evidence_limits: No site measurement or geodetic survey was performed.
Photo viewpoints have no verified compass bearing and do not supply calibrated dimensions.
Published existence and appearance do not establish structural adequacy, accessible circulation or safe lift operation.
Technical validation and matched comparison images must be recorded separately; this source record does not claim completed validation or human acceptance.
Exterior panorama adds visible structural context, but no calibrated present-day full shaft elevation or plan has been obtained.
T_018 contains ceiling reflections; reflected members were not counted as duplicate real structures. The black loop in that photo is not modeled because its function and endpoints are unknown.

comparison_plan.status: Comparison rendering and validation results are recorded separately after completion.

distribution.reference_media: Third-party photographs and PDFs are reference-only and are not included in this repository or distributed with the model.
